rw [show restrictedResidue a ham z = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) c) • restrictedResidue a ham h by ext d; simp [coeff_restrictedResidue, hfactor, coeff_C_mul]]
exact MvPolynomial.support_smul_eq ((hc.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))).ne_zero) _
explanation: The residue polynomial of z is the scalar multiple of the residue polynomial of h by the image of c. Since c is a unit, its image in the maximal-ideal quotient is nonzero. MvPolynomial.support_smul_eq then gives equality of supports. The supplied proof instead establishes support equality coefficientwise.
